title: Triangulated derived quasi-coherator for qcqs algebraic spaces
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Assume $X$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated: it admits a surjective etale map from a quasi-compact scheme, and $U\times_X V$ is quasi-compact for every pair of affine etale scheme charts $U,V\to X$ [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Use the small etale structure sheaf and the equivalent small ringed model [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and the unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be its full triangulated subcategory of objects with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. The inclusion $I_X:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)\hookrightarrow D(\mathcal O_X)$ has a right adjoint $DQ_X$. This adjoint is a triangulated functor [def-weil-triangulated-category]. With counit $\epsilon:I_XDQ_X\to\mathrm{id}$, composition with $\epsilon_E$ gives natural bijections $$\operatorname{Hom}_{D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}}(P,DQ_XE)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal O_X)}(I_XP,E).$$ The unit $\mathrm{id}\to DQ_XI_X$ is an isomorphism. No Noetherian, separatedness, finite-type or finite-dimensional hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0CR4 (lemma-better-coherator); triangulated adjoint structure as in derived.tex Tag 0A8D (lemma-adjoint-is-exact).

proof.text: Use the specified small ringed model of $X_{\mathrm{et}}$. Its module category is Grothendieck by [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian], and an equivalence of abelian categories preserves this property, so the module sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ form a Grothendieck category through the retained restriction equivalence. Hence [lem-kun-grothendieck-derived-coproducts] gives all set-indexed coproducts in $D(\mathcal O_X)$, represented by termwise coproducts of complexes. All indexing sets and Hom sets are taken in the fixed common universe; no larger-indexed coproduct is used.

source.place: Tag 08F3, lemma-quasi-coherence-direct-sums, proof; injectives.tex Tag 07D9, lemma-derived-products

proof.text: First, the item's hypothesis is the one used by the cited space results. A surjective etale map from a quasi-compact scheme makes the point space $|X|$ quasi-compact by the final clause of [lem-a1-space-finite-affine-subatlas]. Quasi-compactness of every $U\times_XV$ for affine etale scheme charts $U,V\to X$ is equivalent, by [lem-sfb-etale-affine-pairs-test-quasiseparated] applied to $X$ viewed as an algebraic space over $\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ through $S\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$, to quasi-compactness of the absolute diagonal. Put $C_X=D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. By [lem-sfb-space-perfect-localizing-generation], $C_X$ is a strictly full subcategory closed under shifts, distinguished-triangle cones and ambient set-indexed coproducts. It therefore inherits its triangulated structure, and $I_X$ is exact. For any family in $C_X$, its ambient coproduct belongs to $C_X$; fullness identifies its maps to each $T\in C_X$ with the ambient maps, so the ambient coproduct universal property is also the one in $C_X$. Thus $I_X$ preserves coproducts. By [lem-sfb-space-compact-perfect-generator] there is a compact $P\in C_X$ detecting zero objects by all $\operatorname{Hom}(P[n],-)$, $n\in\mathbf Z$. The singleton family $\{P\}$ therefore compactly generates $C_X$ by [def-pc-compactly-generated]: the condition using $P[n]$ is the condition using $P$ and shifts of the target after replacing $n$ by $-n$.

source.place: Tag 0CR4, lemma-better-coherator, Second proof; Tags 09IY and 09M8

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-brown-representability-right-adjoint] to $I_X:C_X\to D(\mathcal O_X)$. Its source and target are triangulated and have set-indexed coproducts by the preceding steps; its source is compactly generated and it preserves these coproducts. It follows that $I_X$ has a right adjoint $DQ_X$. This uses only quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of $X$, the hypotheses of the generator and closure results; none requires $X$ to be Noetherian, separated, of finite type or finite dimensional.

source.place: Tag 0CR4, lemma-better-coherator, Second proof; derived.tex Tag 0A8G, proposition-brown

proof.text: Give $I_X$ its inherited coherent integer-shift isomorphisms. Clause (iii) of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-shift-compatibility-unique] supplies the compatible coherent shift isomorphisms on its right adjoint, with shift-compatible unit and counit. Now [lem-sf-triangulated-right-adjoint] applies to this precise adjunction: $I_X$ is exact, so $DQ_X$ is exact with that shift structure. Thus the right adjoint is triangulated.

source.place: Tag 0A8D, lemma-adjoint-is-exact; canonical shift construction and exactness

proof.text: Write $\eta$ and $\epsilon$ for this adjunction. By the definition of the adjunction, the Hom bijection in the displayed direction sends $a:P\to DQ_XE$ to $\epsilon_E\circ I_X(a)$. Its inverse sends $b:I_XP\to E$ to $DQ_X(b)\circ\eta_P$; naturality and the two triangle identities show these maps are mutually inverse and natural in $P,E$. Finally, the inclusion of a full subcategory is fully faithful. Apply [lem-sp-adjunction-unit-fully-faithful-left] to $I_X\dashv DQ_X$: $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to DQ_XI_X$ is a natural isomorphism, as claimed.

lean.statement: theorem exists_derivedCoheratorAdjunction {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.SmallModules] (hqc : ∃ (U : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj), CompactSpace U.left ∧ IsEtale a ∧ IsSurjective a) (hqs : ∀ (U V : Over S) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ X.obj.obj), IsAffine U.left → IsAffine V.left → IsEtale a → IsEtale b → ∃ W : Over S, Nonempty (yoneda.obj W ≅ Limits.pullback a b) ∧ CompactSpace W.left) : ∃ (DQ : X.DerivedModules ⥤ X.DerivedQCoh) (adj : X.derivedQCohProperty.ι ⊣ DQ), @Functor.IsTriangulated _ _ _ _ _ _ DQ (adj.rightAdjointCommShift ℤ) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ∧ (∀ (P : X.DerivedQCoh) (E : X.DerivedModules), Function.Bijective (fun a : P ⟶ DQ.obj E ↦ X.derivedQCohProperty.ι.map a ≫ adj.counit.app E)) ∧ IsIso adj.unit
lean.note: Uses the existing small-model DerivedModules and DerivedQCoh and their inherited triangulation. The quasi-compact atlas and affine etale overlap hypotheses are rendered directly; overlap compactness is compactness of a representing scheme. The exactness conclusion uses the canonical right-adjoint integer-shift structure of this precise adjunction.
